UKPSC Upper PCS Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Uttarakhand Public Service Commission (UKPSC) has released the notification for the post of Combined State Civil/ Upper Subordinate Services PCS Exam 2026. This recruitment has been issued for 67 posts. The online application process for UKPSC Upper PCS Recruitment 2026 has started on 09 September 2026, and candidates can apply till 29 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for UKPSC Upper PCS Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 09 September 2026
  • Last Date : 29 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 29 September 2026
  • Correction Date : 07-16 October 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 166.36/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 76.36/-
  • PH : Rs. 16.36/-
  • Orphan (Anath) : Rs. 00/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

Important Links

  • Apply Online
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is UKPSC Upper PCS Online Form 2026?

UKPSC Upper PCS Online Form 2026 is an official government examination / recruitment update. Full details and direct links are provided on this page.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
